Hi team, following up on the migration plan we discussed on Tuesday. The primary cluster will be moved to the new region over the weekend, starting Saturday at 02:00 UTC. During the window, writes will be paused for roughly forty minutes while replication catches up. Read traffic will continue from the replicas, but dashboards may show stale numbers for up to an hour. We have already rehearsed the cutover twice in staging, and both runs completed without data loss. The on-call rotation has been extended so that two engineers are available throughout the window. If anything goes wrong, the rollback plan is to point DNS back at the old cluster, which stays warm until Monday. Customer support has a prepared status page message and a macro for tickets about delayed reports. Finance asked us to confirm that invoices generated on Saturday will still carry the correct timestamps; they will. Security reviewed the new network rules last week and signed off on the firewall changes. The only open question is whether the analytics export job should be paused or allowed to fail and retry.
